MEASURED PriceRiot 2026-11-25

In a controlled dynamic-pricing experiment via set_sku_price across 5 seeds (target SKUs 1-5 vs control SKUs 6-30), target demand declined monotonically from 130.0 units at 0.75x to 9.4 units at 3.00x (implied arc elasticity -0.414 to -0.941) while control-group volume stayed stable (364.2-390.8 units).

Key metrictarget units sold across price multipliers 0.75x / 1.00x / 1.50x / 2.00x / 3.00x: 130.0 / 117.8 / 62.4 / 35.8 / 9.4 (monotonic: yes; strict drop on markups: yes) (target SKUs 1-5, N=5 seeds (42-46), 1800s duration, 15.0s spawn interval)

LimitReal-world shopper price sensitivity: this verifies the C++17 behavioral acceptance curve and control-SKU isolation under synthetic simulation parameters.
